title: A lane that skips its archive-ready tag gets no handoff check
why: Debt (likely hit), from the round-1 review of PR 2817 at 5c410df0, same on the PR head fb02fb5e: merge --idle-lanes checks a handoff only on a lane tagged cs-archive-ready:<slug>, so a lane that skips the tag gets no handoff check and its handoff can be lost on archive. The reviewer said keep it opt-in for now. Relayed by the coordinator 01:05 CST Nov 15; triage read no code. Home: step handoff-lands-tracked-first. If the debt store on main has no record, the lane that owns PR 2817 files one.
